vetSays.line: A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." Company makes the road shorter.
💧 A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "We need more firewood before dark. Who's with me?"
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "Okay — what's the first step?"
👂 A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek "Hey — come here. You should hear this."
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek and Rosa are arguing about the watch rotation. Again. It's almost comforting.
"Can we talk?" A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Tom telling A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about you. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "We need more firewood before dark. Who's with me?"
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "If we rotate the watch, nobody pulls two nights running. Fair's fair."

You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "Good. I'll take the first rotation. Somebody has to."
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Javier, Tom, Rosa and Ivy met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Tom, Ivy are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Javier, Victor, Tariq and Rosa met them at the door — 4 put down. Javier, Victor, Tariq, Rosa are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Javier, Victor, Tariq, Rosa and Ivy met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Javier, Victor, Tariq, Ivy are hurt.
◈ THE WAR PATH — The body count, itemized. The System is not making this up — it was filming. On day 100, you put down The Influencer. On day 94, Farid put down The Herald.

"THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced Big-Eyes and lived to sit here. They faced The Big Beast and lived to sit here. 1 more of the later drafts faced besides. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (1 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
